Framing the March 20, 2019 FOMC statement through the Financial Stability Report lens mildly reinforces the Committee’s cautious, patient stance. The FSR highlights elevated asset valuations and high business leverage (with some signs of weaker underwriting), subdued market-based inflation compensation, and a flatter yield curve—all consistent with a shallower expected policy path. At the same time, the FSR notes low funding risks and resilient banks, tempering downside concerns. Taken together, these financial stability considerations support holding rates and continuing reinvestments, tilting the tone modestly more dovish than the statement alone while remaining balanced about continued expansion.
